notes.title: Soundtrack High Quality Audio Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The Nekojishi Original Soundtrack has been converted to be a native soundtrack item on Steam. This means that instead of finding your soundtrack files within the game installation folder, you can now access them directly in your Steam library.

In addition we’ve added a new FLAC version download which was derived from the original master files. Thank you for your continued support of Nekojishi!

The files included in the soundtrack are as follows:
[list]
[*] MP3: 320 Kbps 44.1 kHz
[*] FLAC: 48 kHz
[/list]
- From the team at Studio Klondike

https://store.steampowered.com/app/769180/Nekojishi_Original_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Nekojishi v1.06 Released! [Anniversary Update]
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157122/fa611e517fc4c8c0c5296d46fe86466ca4134310.jpg[/img]


[h1]Nekojishi Anniversary Update[/h1]

It's been over one year since Nekojishi was released! To celebrate, v1.06 has been released. This includes English script updates. A Japanese script revision is also underway!

Please look forward to further announcements coming soon! Please follow our [url=https://twitter.com/NekojishiTW]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://facebook.com/nekojishi]Facebook[/url] to keep up to date on anything new.


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated English script for both base game and DLC.
[*]Updated Japanese script for the DLC.
[*]Partial Japanese script update for base game.
[/list]

PS: If you find any typos or mistakes left in the English script at this point, don't hesitate to send us an email at nekojishitw@gmail.com.

notes.title: Store Page and Achievement Update
notes.notes:
It's been a long time coming but we've finally updated the store page with new descrptions and screenshots as well as revised the achievement names and descriptions in preparation for an upcoming update!

[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] New English store description that better reflects the story and tone of Nekojishi.
[*] English screenshots. (Finally!) Think of these as a tease of the upcoming update!
[*] New achievement names and descriptions. These have been revised by our English editor to read better and more closely convey the reasons you unlocked them.
[/list]

Thanks for everyone's continued support!

- Team Nekojishi
